name: Hello Neighbor [3 Acts]
desc:
✨ Hello Neighbor is a stealth horror game where you try to get inside the neighbor's basement by solving puzzles✨

👍 Support the game by giving a LIKE and a FAVORITE!

ACT 1 AND ACT 2 AREN'T ACTIVELY SUPPORTED || PLAY ACT 3 FOR THE BEST EXPERIENCE

💻Controls💻
E - Pick up item, open doors
Shift - Sprint
Right Mouse Button - Drop item
Left Mouse Button - Use item

🎮Controls🎮
X - Pick up item, open doors
L1; L2, R1 - Sprint
B - Drop item
R2, Y - Use item
D-pad - inventory slots
